'''Matt White''' is a Star Wars CCG player who finished 5th at [[March 2001 Toledo tournament (18 March)]] on 18 March 2001, according to Brad Eier's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1918">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-toledo-oh-3-18-00-bring-in-the-bacond1918/ toledo-oh-3-18-00-bring-in-the-bacon], DeckTech (brad "swccguy" eier, 19 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-19-toledo-oh-3-18-00-bring-in-the-bacond1918/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
